question: Mukesh starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the North. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, then turns left and drives 17 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Mukesh starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, then turns left and drives 17 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km, and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97e29cb7f857824f1750f54a22578dff45bbeb31e7af4e9247dbcae7d2de2e03.png] 

So, He should drive **4 km to the west** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
